sec: sec:E012: Document regulatory compliance / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:E012: Document regulatory compliance / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Identifying relevant regulations. For example, data protection laws. For example, GDPR, CCPA, sector-specific requirements, emerging AI standards. For example, EU AI Act.

blocks.id: blk:E012: Document regulatory compliance / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Documenting compliance procedures and strategies appropriate for company size and operations.

blocks.id: blk:E012: Document regulatory compliance / Control shoulds/3
blocks.text: Reviewing the repository every 6 months and when additional requirements may be triggered. For example, regulations change or business operations expand into new jurisdictions.
